note: Terms module-05 introduces, and the build that teaches each. Enforced by scripts/lint-glossary.mjs. Keep ASCII-only.

terms.gloss: Compare what the books say with what an outside source says, and explain the difference. An account is reconciled when the difference is explained, not when it is zero.
The governed dollar line: a difference at or above it is booked; below it, it is logged as a passed item.
A difference too small to book, logged so it is not forgotten. Passed items add up, and their total is reported.
A booked correction to the ledger, with a reason and the name of who prepared it.
The person who prepared an entry may not be the one who approves it. A control, enforced by the flow.
The Controller's formal sign-off that the package is complete and correct.
Business days counted from the first day of the month. The package is due on Workday 5.
Carrying this month's certified balances into next month as the openings its movement is measured from.
